test_title: PYST 54: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

________ ! Watch out for that hole.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hey"** is an exclamation used to attract attention or to warn someone. (अरे) • **Example: **"**Hey!** Watch out for that car!" • **"Hey"** is the most appropriate word to use in a situation requiring immediate attention or warning. Here, the sentence demands attention. Therefore, the correct sentence is** "Hey!__ Watch out for that hole."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Amen** (आमीन): Used to express agreement or affirmation. • **Example:** The pastor ended the prayer with** "Amen,"** and the congregation repeated it. • **Yay** (वाह): An exclamation of excitement or joy. • **Example: Yay!** We won the match! • **Tut** (चिः): An exclamation used to express annoyance or disapproval. • **Example:** **Tut, tut,** you should have known better than to do that. 2f:Td6a,
